information_cutoff: End of November 12, 2026 America/New_York; all verified filings published on or before that date
boundary: Dated source and input-method review, not a complete DCF or certification of current daily balances.
methodology_decisions: Keep annual histories and saved valuation inputs unchanged. Current-dated estimates cannot fill historical annual source gaps.
Use explicitly scoped financing roll-forwards as research subtotals; withhold complete debt until repayment, cash and lease scopes reconcile.
Record narrow trade cash absorption without substituting it for full NWC. Default FCFF sales-to-capital reinvestment does not require this missing historical decomposition.
Use gross award marks for exposure review only. Do not install them as employee option values or combine them with award dilution.
Use Alphabet NCI book value and separately quoted preferred series as explicit modeling proxies; retain source-date and conversion limitations.
Hold Meta preferred valuation because the primary-source prices conflict. Do not choose the favorable quote or invent a resolution.

(the “Company”) completed an offering of €1,750,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 4.300% Senior Notes due 2031 (the “2031 Notes”), €1,250,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 4.650% Senior Notes due 2033 (the “2033 Notes”), €1,000,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 4.900% Senior Notes due 2035 (the “2035 Notes”), €1,750,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 5.400% Senior Notes due 2038 (the “2038 Notes”), €1,750,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 6.050% Senior Notes due 2044 (the “2044 Notes”), and €1,500,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 6.400% Senior Notes due 2065 (the “2065 Notes” and, together with the 2031 Notes, the 2033 Notes, the 2035 Notes, the 2038 Notes, and the 2044 Notes, the “EUR Notes”).
